# Roadmap

**Last updated:** YYYY-MM-DD.

Rules for this file, kept here so the roadmap itself holds only rows:

- Rows are grouped by area: a `##` heading per area, and a `###` block inside it when the area has
  several groups.
- Every block uses one table: `# | builds | why`. Notes under a table are free form.
- A row is worth having on its own. A feature is one row, and its notes hold the outline; the epics
  wait for PLAN.md.
- Every row is to-do. When a row starts, it leaves this file: its notes move to PLAN.md, and anything
  the initiative will not do becomes its own row.

  - [Block](#block)
